reason: This is a broad planner/executor refactor around `PhysicalLimit`/TopN, touching core plan construction, physical plan generation, task building, plan clone/cache code, plan serialization (`plan_to_pb`/`pb_to_plan`), executor building, MPP coordination, and runtime TopN behavior. Even if framed as a move/refactor, `LIMIT` is central query semantics and required-rows/pushdown behavior, so mistakes here can cause wrong-result or high-blast-radius execution bugs.
